turns.doctor_question: Hi, I’m glad you came in. What brings you in today?
turns.patient_response: I’m here because I’m having a hard time finishing things all the way through at work. Like, I’ll start the sanitation steps, or the batch logs, or the end-of-line paperwork, and somehow I’ll leave out the last parts. I know it’s important, and I know my job depends on doing it right, but I keep missing the follow-through.

symptom_reasoning.S004: The patient reports repeatedly starting required work tasks but leaving out their final parts despite recognizing their importance.

turns.doctor_question: Did you have trouble finishing schoolwork when you were a child?
turns.patient_response: Yes. My mom actually still has some of my elementary school report cards, like from around fourth grade, and they say I was bright but needed a lot of reminders to finish classwork and turn in homework. I remember understanding the lessons, but I’d miss parts of the instructions unless the teacher was right there checking on me.
